scripts.dev:proxy: npx wrangler pages dev --proxy 3000 --d1 DB=777ac36d-0a4f-4996-9c38-201fed833d73 --r2 bucket --persist-to ./local-db-info
scripts.pages:dev: npm run pages:build && npx wrangler pages dev .vercel/output/static --d1 DB=777ac36d-0a4f-4996-9c38-201fed833d73 --r2 bucket --persist-to ./local-db-info
scripts.db:push:local: echo "y" | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to ./local-db-info
scripts.db:push:remote: echo "y" | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: npx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./drizzle/seed.sql --persist-to ./local-db-info && bash scripts/seed-media.sh
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf ./local-db-info && npm run db:push:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:reset:fast: rm -rf ./local-db-info/v3/d1 && npm run db:push:local && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./drizzle/seed.sql --persist-to ./local-db-info
scripts.db:reset:remote: echo '🚨 BAHAYA: Reset TOTAL Cloudflare (DB & Media)? (y/N)' && read confirm && [ "$confirm" = "y" ] && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command='DROP TABLE IF EXISTS d1_migrations; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS __drizzle_migrations; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS notifications; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS admin_logs; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS wishlists; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS product_images; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS qc_reviews; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS products; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS categories;' && echo "y" | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=./drizzle/seed.sql && bash scripts/seed-media.sh --remote
scripts.db:reset:fast:remote: echo '⚡ Fast Reset Cloudflare Database Relational (Keeping R2 Media)? (y/N)' && read confirm && [ "$confirm" = "y" ] && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command='DELETE FROM notifications; DELETE FROM admin_logs; DELETE FROM wishlists; DELETE FROM product_images; DELETE FROM qc_reviews; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM users; DELETE FROM categories;' && echo "y" | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=./drizzle/seed.sql
